gold_points: Fixed-price contracts are exposed to cost overruns not recoverable via change orders, risking reduced profits or losses
Cost-plus and time-and-materials work has lower risk, so margins are usually lower than fixed-price
Progress billings occur at milestones, with retention withheld until work is completed
Labor, materials and overhead are most of cost of service; labor utilization drives performance
output.note: Fixed-price contract terms and retainage are in chunk 1; cost-overrun risk and cost-plus margins are in chunk 2, so both are needed.
output.question: How does Comfort Systems USA describe the risks and payment mechanics of its fixed-price project contracts, compared with cost-plus work, in its fiscal 2024 10-K?
